prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: NPC portrait eye atlas for Daggerfall Unity
Input image: Image 1 is the exact NPC072 eyes-reference-grid.png. Use it as the only visual reference.
Primary request: Create one 2x2 atlas of four complete copies of the same woman's original 64x35 upper-face crop, in row-major order: OPEN, HALF CLOSED, FULLY CLOSED, OPEN REPEAT. Canvas ratio 64:35. Each cell has the same full crop, framing, scale, eye spacing, hair, forehead, nose bridge and cheeks. No labels, gutters, borders, panels or zoomed features.
Expression: Make all four cells clearly warmer and happier than the neutral reference, with softly relaxed eyes, gently lifted outer brow arcs, slight lower-lid/outer-corner smile creases. Keep brows natural and close to their source shape. Happy, not surprised or wide-eyed.
Identity and palette: Preserve source identity, skin, golden-brown hair, muted warm-brown shadows, small brown/olive irises, original iris size and center placement, and tiny source-like eye highlights. Keep natural softened pixel clusters. Do not enlarge or shift eyes, stretch irises, add white flashes, or use hard black outlines.
Blink phases: HALF and FULLY CLOSED preserve the OPEN-phase brow placement. HALF shows a natural partial upper-lid closure. FULLY CLOSED hides both eyes opaquely with natural skin-toned lids; no visible iris or eye white. OPEN REPEAT matches OPEN.
Constraints: Change eyes and subtle adjacent expression lines only. Preserve complete upper-half crop and all exterior registration. No extra subject, text, watermark, smoothing, vector circles, severe wrinkles, or exaggerated grin.
